parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, a lightweight and flexible plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and fit.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, a durable and flexible plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral support and stability, resting on the wearer’s ear to hold the glasses in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot around the hinge to fold inward or extend outward for use.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, made of polycarbonate for impact resistance and clarity.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the optical correction or protection function of the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central structure to which the legs are attached via hinges.
